items.title: 🌍⚡ The future of energy is being debated. What side will you take?...
items.author: vie_etudiante_um5
items.content:
🌍⚡ The future of energy is being debated. What side will you take?

Join us for our COP Simulation: Fossil Fuels vs. Renewable Energy, an interactive experience where participants step into the shoes of climate negotiators to explore one of today’s most pressing challenges: how to achieve a just and sustainable energy transition.

💬 Challenge perspectives.

🤝 Negotiate solutions.

🌱 Rethink the future of energy.

📅 November 3, 2026 | 3:30 PM

📍 Pôle Vie Étudiante, UM5 – Agdal

🎓 Participants will receive an e-certificate of participation.

⚠️ Limited seats available! Scan the QR code on the poster to register and secure your spot.

Are you ready to negotiate the energy transition? 🌿

#copsimulation#energytransition#renewableenergy#climateaction#sustainabledevelopment

La tournée des ambassadeurs de l’Université Mohammed V de Rabat poursuit son itinéraire au sein du campus ! 🎓

📍 Destination : Faculté de Médecine Dentaire de Rabat (FMD)
